review_response_tasks.stem: Please close the library door ____, so that the readers can keep working. (quiet)
review_response_tasks.rationale: quietly：副词quietly修饰close，符合图书馆语境。；quiet：形容词不在此处直接修饰close。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: My aunt has ____ across Canada by train twice. (travel)
review_response_tasks.rationale: travelled：has后过去分词，双l为英式常用形式。；traveled：单l为词典列出的美式过去分词，同等接受。；travel：has后需要过去分词。；travelling：has后不能直接接-ing构成此完成时。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: The padded seat felt softer and supported my back better. It was ____ than the hard stool. (comfortable)
review_response_tasks.rationale: more comfortable：前句具体舒适性比较支持more comfortable，than需要比较级。；comfortable：原级不能直接承接此than比较。；most comfortable：最高级不合此than比较。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: Mr Hill drives the school bus. He is its ____. (drive)
review_response_tasks.rationale: driver：its后表示开车的人用单数名词driver。；drive：此义需人物名词，不是drive。；drivers：题面一名Mr Hill对应单数，不用复数。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。

review_response_tasks.stem: Mum was ____ the small parcel in brown paper when the phone rang. (wrap)
review_response_tasks.rationale: wrapping：was后主动进行时用wrapping，双写p。；wrap：was后不能接原形构成此主动进行时。；wraping：漏双写p，不是规范词形。；未列出的形式尚未穷尽核实，显示待复核，不据此断言错误。
